verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Pods can be connected to via JupyterLab for data science workflows or VS Code/Cursor for local IDE integration, alongside SSH and web proxy, directly from a deployed Pod. Templates pre-configure JupyterLab so it's ready instantly without manual setup. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the 'one-step' VS Code/Cursor connect experience and any friction noted (community evidence only discusses SSH, not IDE integration specifically).
